findings.summary: Registry --check succeeds when the generated target is missing
findings.details: The S05-T01 contract requires the migration registry generator to require packages/convex/confect/internal/migrations.generated.ts to exist in check mode and requires a failure-first test proving a missing generated target fails. The implementation instead exits 0 when the target is absent, and the focused test removes the target then asserts --check succeeds. This creates a false-green integration-owned generated-file proof: a lane can pass exact-head registry checks without any generated registry artifact present in the transient snapshot.

findings.summary: S05 source schema implements Slack verification outside its layer and task scope
findings.details: S05-T01 is explicitly schema/registry-only and must not perform secret lookup, admit replay, or expose a constructor for the verified Slack envelope; those runtime responsibilities belong to S04-T03 and S05-T02. The new sourceSchemas module adds NativeSlackVerificationInput and verifyNativeSlackEnvelope, accepts signingSecret/rawBody/signature/replayAdmission, computes Slack HMACs, checks timestamp/replay, and brands a VerifiedSlackEnvelope. Even without secret lookup, this embeds provider verification and replay-admission behavior in the source-ledger schema layer and expands the task beyond the approved slice.

findings.summary: Migration ref dispatch still falls back to probeExpand for unknown names
findings.details: The task requires unknown migration IDs to retain the typed MigrationNotFound path and never fall back to the probe. validateExecuteRequest/findExecutableMigration does provide the typed rejection path, and tests exercise the public mutation path, but migrationRef remains a separate name-to-ref dispatcher that returns probeExpand for every unrecognized name. That default is a maintainability and false-green hazard for the extracted registry: any future caller or future registered migration name that reaches this helper without an explicit branch will execute probeExpand instead of failing or forcing registration coverage.
